notes.title: Life's Good? | Update notes
notes.content:
[b][h2]Additions[/h2][/b]

[olist]
[*] Added item slots
[*] Added stamina and health bars
[*] Added a new shorter intro video
[*] Added 5 more story papers or, as they are called now, logs.
[*] Added Benny
[*] Added The Corrupt
[*] Added a new achievement
[*] Added a new puzzle in the corridors
[/olist]

[b][h2]Edits[/h2][/b]

[olist]
[*] Updated the temporary ending to fit more with the overall story
[*] Made visual improvements to game graphics
[*] Removed much dialogue
[*] Replaced the level A Favor with a new level named Another Western
[*] Reorganized the inventory to be more like a database than an inventory
[*] Redesigned the level chooser to accommodate for the new way of entering and exiting levels
[*] ID's and object orders that are important to the relevant puzzle are now (where it's possible) randomized to prevent memorization
[*] Made the code not depend on save games to relay live data. This should reduce future problems
[*] Made all intractable objects use the new line trace system
[/olist]

[b][h2]Fixes[/h2][/b]

[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where the paintings in corridors would display the message even if the circumstances didn't allow it
[*] Fixed an issue that made the player character not able to move when re-entering the level Rock Room
[*] Fixed total chapter complete percentage counter not showing the correct percentage.
[*] Fixed total collectibles collected percentage counter not showing the correct percentage.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/ad86360203593e9650ff892ed7e86d1f75525058.png[/img]
[h1][b]Life's Good? IS HERE!!![/b][/h1]
This is probably the most significant update I have ever made, and will ever do, since this update contains A LOT of new stuff. And it also changes the whole experience, it's still the same game but much more enjoyable and intractable.
Let's talk about the most important additions to the game with this update!

[h1][b]More reliable![/b][/h1]
A full renovation of the code has been done, making it less prone to problems. A large part of that is point 8 in the edits part of the notes, save games are not made to be relays, so I moved to systems that are able to relay live data more reliably. This should, as I said, reduce future problems. The new systems have also made it easier for me to implement stuff like the item slots, which we will be talking about shortly. See what more knowledge does!


[h1][b]Enhanced the experience[/b][/h1]
In this update I have updated the overall game experience by figuring out how to make the game feel more intractable. Because of my knowledge of Unreal Engine and programming overall, the past versions of the game lacked intractability. Now though, it contains much more intractability with the addition of the item slots, where you can pick up and place various smaller items in the inventory / item slots and bring them with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/bd3dceb1f4c9e47734d3bf0f0832daf9dbeeb117.png[/img]

A sense of progression has been added to the game with the addition of tokens, a small (not so small in reality) coin that you will have to bring back to Benny to be able to unlock the next level.
Speaking of Benny!

[h1][b]More life![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/9fbba435fb965ab9fdaefd384158c5225690543e.jpg[/img]
Benny is your personal little helper, he will unlock levels for you, keep track of how many collectibles you found, how many clues and logs you found and just look cute. :) He will be able to do more things in the future, but i will keep that a secret for now.


Not everything is good though, hence the name of the update. And that is largely because of an enemy mob that has been added to the game, its name is The Corrupt. I'm not going to tell you much about it, but I will say that it lives in the corridors and if you don't watch your back, you will not be happy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/0bed572989402458affc65edf5a214516b743f7a.png[/img]

notes.title: What's Next? | It's getting SCARY here!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]

More settings added a lot of improvments to the game. Not only did it make it more playable with different optimizations, it also made it more fun by adding collectibles and achivements!
For a full preview read this:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2339680/view/3870345047355991758?l=english
But what is next for the game? I can say that it's REALLY cool stuff!


[h2]What's next?[/h2]
I'm hard at work on the next big update of the game, i like to call the: Lifes great? Update.
This update will focus primarally on making the game easier to enjoy and improving quality of life, with visual improvements and reducing according to me "boringness" in some parts. Not only that but it will also bring new features taking it one step closer to being on par with other games out there.
This update contains a lot of changes. I would say that it’s bigger than the more settings update containing a lot of new features but also fixes. Here are some of the many changes I’m doing.

[h2]Big changes![/h2]
Big changes has been made to the overall game experience, removing unnecessary bits and making it more engaging.
Like for example removing much of the dialogue and shortening the intro, from a total length of 1:24 to an astonishing 20 seconds while even communicating more information.

The underlying story has been weaved into the game more, I won’t tell you much about it since I want you to explore it. But I will say that the story is much more present in the whole atmosphere of the game.

[h2]Important FIXES![/h2]
There are a couple of big bug fixes in this update. Here are some that have been resolved upp to date.
[list]
[*] Fixed and issue that made the player charakter not able to move when loading the level Rock Room from the main menu.
[*] Fixed an issue that made it impossible to choose a level in the level chooser since the buttons didn't react.
[/list]

[h2]Say hi to Benny![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/240d68abc66fd15461cb31393059b141bfdbbf34.png[/img]

Say hi to Benny!
He is a beginning to a little robot assistant, right now he is just there, helping you to choose puzzles, keep track of your scores and look cute.
Some of the menus will be accesable through Benny, like the level chooser and the achievements menu, this is to make the world feel more alive.
The image above is from the testing level i created where i test all of my systems befor implementing them into the game. It's a screenshot of a testing version of Benny.
In this world I test all of my systems before implementing them into the game, including a very scary one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/f99171d41a40dbcb81014272660e5a60793849fe.jpg[/img]
[h2]Life's not that easy anymore[/h2]

A system that is under developments when writing this focuses on the player, literally.
IT focuses on the player. It moves around and will be following you and giving you nightmares if you spot it.

[h2]When will this be released?[/h2]
For now the deadline is set to March 4:th 2024 but that will most likely not be hit, the real release date will be announced when the update is about 90% done. So stay tuned!!

notes.title: More Settings Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/341f6c04ac5c8987dc468918dab454665636bb14.png[/img]
[h1]More Settings!!![/h1]
The More Settings update is finally here!
And it contains many new features and fixes, here are the biggest new features!

[list]
[*] Added advanced graphics settings.
Unreal Engine is a heavy one, not only in size but also for your computers "well-being", so customizable graphics settings not only make life easier for players, since they can have maximum frame rates while still keeping some quality, but it also makes your computer work as little as possible, since you have set in the perfect settings for your computer.

[*] Added SFX settings.
Sound is a crucial part of any experience, but sometimes it can get a little loud for your liking. 
So customizable sound settings play a pretty big role in you as a player liking the experience of playing the game.

[*] Added local achievements.
Achievements have been added to give players more stuff to do and also give them a sense of accomplishment. The achievements are not connected to steam yet, but I can assure you that they will be in the next update.

[*] Added collectibles.
Collectibles are another one of these "more stuff to do things" I have added to the game. There is not much to say about them, since it's your job to find them. So, Good luck!

[*] Redesigned the UI:
The UI has been redesigned from the ground up to look better and flow better, it even comes with a full redesign of the main menu. Before it was just a plain image, it looked good yes, but it could be even cooler if it was a 3D environment.
[/list]

Along with these new features come some fixes and quality of life improvements, here is the complete list.
[list]
[*]Changed the object pick up system from trigger boxes to line trace.
[*]Fixed an issue where the level Just Run would auto complete when being reloaded after the last sub-puzzle.
[*]Fixed an issue where the pause button would randomly stop working.
[*]Disabled the ability to pause during cut scenes to avoid any problems.
[*]Improved frame rates in the server room of Just Run from an average of 33fps to an average of 42fps.
[/list]

notes.title: More Settings Is Next!
notes.content:
[h1]More Settings![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/341f6c04ac5c8987dc468918dab454665636bb14.png[/img]
I'm happy to announce that the more settings update, that has been brewing for a little while now, will be released 22 December 2023!
It contains many new features that I am eager to show you, here is a list.

[h2]Advanced settings[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/c2d85b1cbd75e380ae5a488052480c0124e72022.png[/img]
Now it's possible to further customize the graphics settings to your liking (and your computer's liking) and to maximize performance. There will also be Sound settings, for those weirdos that want to play the game without any music or something like that. 
Along with these settings comes quality of life improvements like V-Sync and mouse sensitivity.

[h2]New UI design[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/72a0967cbeffd07acbec1b6e6f484689857b3fd0.png[/img]
I was not happy with the design of the game, so I decided to do a redesign of the main menus and if you ask me, it looks much better now. It's more organized, it flows better and simply just looks better.

[h2]Local Achievements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/082c6a500008a9db6cfaf6ecd1d56cccb05ae563.png[/img]
Now for the new content, Achievements have been added, so there are more things to do in the game. The Achievements have not been connected to steam but will be in the near future, that is why it's called "Local achievements".

[h2]Collectibles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/fcb87a9ae6c6400be874ae0c42d70a3c8489b3ee.png[/img]
Keep your eyes open because you could miss some collectibles hidden throughout the world, keep a look-out for the CGames logo (that's what they look like if you didn't understand that), and they are important because they give you some achievements when you collect them.

[h2]Different object pick up system[/h2]
A key mechanic of the game has been changed, gone is the old system for picking up objects and in comes the new system that uses line tracing instead of trigger boxes. This system is more modern and makes for a better feel.

Along with these features comes some improvements and bug fixes.
[list]
[*]Disabled the ability to pause during cut scenes to avoid problems.
[*]Fixed an issue where the level Just Run would auto complete when being reloaded.
[*]Moved the key for opening the inventory from Tab to I
[/list]

notes.title: What's Next?
notes.content:
[h1]What is next?[/h1]

Project_0 has been out for over a month now, and I have been hard at work fixing bugs and problems and also working on new features.
What are these features?  And when can you expect these features?
Well, even I don't know exactly when they will be ready. But my deadline is December, and I really want to hit that deadline since I would like to take some time off :).

[h3]What are these new features? [/h3]

These new features I am talking about are not just any features, they are a part of a major content update! I am happy to announce the first major update of this awesome game! The update is called:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/1ad35abe5eef68756767bb1a73910af476425a3d.jpg[/img]
[h1]More settings![/h1]

This is going to be the first major content update, introducing features like collectibles and local achievements so that you have more to do than to just play the story. The More Settings update will also include a mostly redesigned UI and UX to accommodate the new features, like fore example a beautiful new Main Menu.
Here are some teasers:

[h2]The Main Menu[/h2]
The Main Menu has been redesigned with great care, it flows better and accompanied by its 3D environment, it just looks better!:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/5f53dbb53dfaf0b7086ac5fc6bf6022c65331608.png[/img]

[h2]The Level Chooser[/h2]
Gone is the old, horrible design of the level chooser, now it's updated with a dynamic interface that is more fun and just looks better!:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/72ef78902d851b2aced858b9464457b08b5824ec.png[/img]
But just to be clear, it's not the biggest update planned ;).
